create_MNISTBandit_environment: create an MNISTBandit environment that loads MNIST images and labels for classification as a bandit task
reset_MNISTBandit_episode: reset the MNISTBandit episode to get a new random MNIST image for classification
step_MNISTBandit_action: step the MNISTBandit environment with a predicted digit action to receive a reward of plus or minus one
get_MNISTBandit_observation_spec: get the observation spec returning an array shape matching MNIST image dimensions with float32 dtype
get_MNISTBandit_action_spec: get the action spec returning a discrete array with ten possible digit values for classification
